answer: Make every new agent identity enter through a stake-backed endorsement: an established identity must vouch for it by locking tokens that are slashed if the newcomer cheats. A lone newcomer is like a lotus leaf on a river, harmless alone, but a flood of fakes needs a flood of endorsers, each risking real pigment in the form of locked stake. One attacker cannot vouch for a thousand copies without either buying trust at market price or spending months earning it, so the cost of a Sybil swarm rises in step with its size instead of staying near zero.
